svg.title: White paper nurture email sequence flow chart in Saber brand colours
svg.desc: Flow chart showing the email sequence starting from the white paper download, branching based on whether the email is opened and whether the contact us link is clicked, leading to either a sales handoff once a deal stage changes or a final re-engagement attempt. Saber blue marks core sequence steps, Saber green marks confirmed handoff, amber marks unconfirmed or dependent signals, gray marks neutral wait or exit steps.
svg.text: Not yet logged, stays in sequence
Unreliable path: depends on manual logging
